front.title: CESAF: The Canonical Email Storage and Archive Format

abstract.t: Email is kept in many incompatible forms: mbox files in several variants, Maildir directories, proprietary personal-folder files and ad hoc exports. Most of them lose or alter information, and each can be read only by some tools. This document specifies CESAF, the Canonical Email Storage and Archive Format: a file-based format in which mail from any source is kept in one store, each message exactly as it was obtained, together with the metadata a reader needs to present it (its source, folders and flags, decoded header fields, MIME structure, character sets and internationalized addresses). Any client that implements this document can read a store written by any other.
